svg.title: Tech stack garden
svg.desc: An illustrated garden with one tree per group of tools; each tool is a fruit with its logo. languages & frameworks (mango tree): Go, Python, Rust, Node.js, TypeScript, echo, Gin, fiber, FastAPI, Flask, Next.js, React; data (coconut palm): MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Apache Kafka, vertica, DBeaver; infra & tools (rambutan tree): Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, aws, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Grafana, uptimerobot, Git, Postman, Swagger, Termius; ai & editors (banana plant): Claude, codex, grok, DeepSeek, aws bedrock, ibm watson, vscode, antigravity, kiro. The banana mascot stands on a bamboo ladder by the mango tree, picks fruit and drops it into its basket.
